title: Two Open Rank Positions in International Relations
institution: Bilkent University, Department of International Relations
about: Bilkent University's Department of International Relations invites applications for two open-rank (Assistant, Associate or Full Professor) positions starting September 2027. Areas of interest include international institutions, migration, environmental, climate and energy politics, and emerging technologies including AI.
requirements: Ph.D. in International Relations, Political Science or a related academic discipline by the beginning of the appointment
CV, cover letter, three recommenders and a writing sample

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "a writing sample" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"Ph.D. in International Relations, Political Science or a related academic discipline" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
